name: usg-maternal-monorepo
description: Monorepo for USG Maternal Healthcare System (Mobile App, Backend API, USG Kiosk Recorder)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mobile install && npm --prefix usg-records install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,mobile,kiosk "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix mobile run start" "npm --prefix usg-records run dev"
